questions.question: What literary form is Ezekiel 27?
options: A song of great praise for all of the wealth of the city of Tyre
A long list of all of the laws of the great trading city of Tyre
A genealogy of all of the kings who had ruled over Tyre
A lamentation over Tyre, pictured as a magnificent ship
questions.answer: A lamentation over Tyre, pictured as a magnificent ship

questions.question: What does the chapter emphasize about Tyre?
options: Its supposed faithfulness to the God of Israel
Its vast wealth and trade with many nations
Its small size and lack of defenses
Its long history of peace with Judah
questions.answer: Its vast wealth and trade with many nations

questions.question: Ezekiel 27 pictures the ship of Tyre wrecked and sunk in the heart of the seas.
O Tyre, you have said, 'I am perfect in _____.'
The merchants among the peoples hiss at you; you have come to a dreadful end and shall be no _____.
